Term of Bid.value: pricing is valid for thirty days from the date of this Quote.

Contract or Cooperative to use.value: This Quote will, if Customer issues a purchase order for the quoted items that is accepted by Supplier, constitute a contract between the entity issuing this Quote (Supplier) and the entity to whom this Quote was issued (Customer).

Product Specification.value: Intel Core Ultra 5 125U processor (12 MB cache, 12 cores, 14 threads, up to 4.3 GHz Turbo); Windows 11 Pro; 16 GB DDR5 5600 MT/s; 256 GB M.2 2230 TLC Gen 4 PCIe NVMe SSD; 15.6 FHD 1920x1080 IPS Non-Touch AG 250 nit 45% NTSC FHD Cam; English US backlit AI hotkey keyboard with numeric keypad; Intel AX211 WLAN Driver Intel Wi-Fi 6E AX211 2x2 802.11ax Bluetooth 5.3 wireless card; 3-cell 54 Wh ExpressCharge Capable battery; 65W AC adapter USB Type-C EcoDesign

Bid Summary.value: This bid is a Purchase Order Request for Proposals (PORFP) for Dell laptops with extended warranty under project BPM044557, with proposals due by 06/10/2024. The solicitation requires 30 Dell Latitude 5550 laptops and 30 Dell Thunderbolt 4 Dock WD22TB4 units, all specified as Microsoft Copilot ready. Awards are restricted to master contractors registered under the Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract participating in a Small Business Reserve (SBR) procurement for Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) goals. Submissions must be delivered electronically through the State's eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA) system, as bids are not accepted via email, fax, mail, or hand delivery.
